title: Reminder e-mails for overdue tasks arrive twice
author: robin-fixture
body:
Since last Tuesday every overdue task produces two reminder e-mails a few seconds apart instead of one. It started when the mail provider was switched.

Please make the reminder job send one e-mail per overdue task per day again.

comments.author: sam-fixture
comments.body: Same here: two copies every morning, with identical subject lines.
